Requirements vary by lender, so confirm with yours.

caption:
$6 coffee. Five years. What could it add up to for a Brampton buyer's down payment?

Example only: set aside $6 a day, 365 days a year.
1) One year: $6 x 365 = $2,190.
2) Five years: $2,190 x 5 = $10,950.
3) Per month over 60 months: $10,950 / 60 = $182.50.
That is about $10,950 toward a down payment, before any interest. Simple arithmetic only.

Want help planning your down payment? Comment INFO to get full details, or call 905-452-4298.

Example only. Not mortgage, tax or legal advice.

caption:
GTA sales fell 7.9% in October. Do buyers have more leverage?

TRREB reports (Market Watch, released Nov 4, 2026): October GTA sales were 5,603, down 7.9% from October 2025, and new listings were 14,173, down 11.9%. The average selling price was $1,024,108, down 2.7% year over year, and the MLS HPI Composite benchmark was down 4.3% year over year. Seasonally adjusted, sales, new listings and prices edged up from September. TRREB says buyers continued to benefit from substantial negotiating power on price.

My take: if you are selling, price to recent sales in your own neighbourhood, not last year's.
